traditional: A soft contact. Love, money, and pleasure supports action, conflict, and heat — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Mars.
modern: Attraction meets drive. Desire, and the channeling of energy into pleasure, art, or pursuit. The conjunction can either fuse charm and drive or have the two cancel out. The trine makes this a natural strength: Popularity and energy that flows easily into creative or romantic pursuits. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Connection and drive flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what connection and drive have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and anger and recklessness go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: Interest and effort move in the same direction without turning the exchange into a chase.
readerCopy.body: Interest and effort move in the same direction without turning the exchange into a chase. Payment clears, the invitation is accepted, the work is divided, or a creative partnership begins with both sides contributing what they offered. Venus keeps the agreement mutually valuable, while Mars gives each person enough drive to participate fully. Under the trine, attraction and action reinforce each other without requiring conflict to keep the energy alive. The arrangement feels easy because nobody is carrying the entire burden of proving that it matters.
